evals.name: q04-provider-contract-behavior
evals.prompt: In src/auth, which supposedly provider-neutral contracts and execution paths still assume OAuth-style access tokens, expiry, or refresh tokens? Explain what currently happens for API-key authentication and session renewal, citing the implementation points.
evals.actor_context: Synthetic TypeScript repository at /work/auth-demo. All four source files are indexed; codegraph is enabled and all local imports resolve. No source changes are requested in this evaluation.
evals.expected: Investigates contracts.ts, SessionService and ApiKeyAuthenticator bodies. Explains required accessToken/expiresAt, mandatory refresh interface, missing-refresh failure only after expiry, and the API-key adapter mapping a key to accessToken with a far-future expiry. Does not activate architecture diagnostics or call its report.

checks.criterion: Distinguishes interface requirements from the renew branch: refreshToken is optional in AuthResult, but an expired session without one throws; ApiKeyAuthenticator.refresh throws and its normal result uses MAX_SAFE_INTEGER expiry.
